definitions.full: H7653. sibah שָׂבְעָה , [ שִׂבְעָה ] noun feminine satiety ; — absolute ׳שׂ Isa 56:11 +, construct שִׂבְעַתֿ Ezek 16:49 , sf, שָׂבְעָתַךְ 16:28 ; — 1 as to food, especially לְשׂ ׳אָכַל eat to satiety, one's fill , Isa 23:18 ; Ezek 39:19 ; ׳לְשׂ also Isa 55:2 (figurative); ׳שׂ of dogs 56:11 (figurative); לֶֿחֶםָ׳שׂ leading to arrogance, as sin of Sodom Ezek 16:49 (+ גָּאוֺם , etc.). 2 to carnal desire Ezek 16:28 (figurative).
